I don’t have real‑time weather data, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what Hanoi usually looks like around this time of year.

| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Rainfall | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|----------|-------|
| Jan   | 18–22             | 8–12             | 70 mm    | Cool, dry, occasional drizzle |
| Feb   | 19–23             | 9–13             | 80 mm    | Still cool, start of spring |
| Mar   | 22–27             | 12–17            | 120 mm   | Warm, more rain |
| Apr   | 26–32             | 16–22            | 200 mm   | Hot, rainy season begins |
| May   | 28–34             | 20–26            | 250 mm   | Very hot, heavy rain |
| Jun   | 28–34             | 21–27            | 300 mm   | Peak rainy season |
| Jul   | 27–33             | 20–26            | 280 mm   | Hot, humid, frequent showers |
| Aug   | 27–33             | 20–26            | 260 mm   | Similar to July |
| Sep   | 25–31             | 18–24            | 200 mm   | Rain starts to taper off |
| Oct   | 22–28             | 15–21            | 120 mm   | Cooler, drier |
| Nov   | 18–23             | 10–15            | 70 mm    | Mild, dry |
| Dec   | 17–21             | 8–12             | 60 mm    | Cool, dry |

If you need the **current** weather (temperature, humidity, forecast, etc.), you can check a reliable weather website or app like Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the forecast for a specific date!
